# MoveYourBody

> MoveYourBody is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0) fitness app by AOSSIE. It builds personalized 5–7 minute micro-workouts around a user's goals, fitness level, equipment, target body region and injuries, adapts after every session from feedback, and runs entirely offline with on-device AI and voice control. This site (https://move.aossie.org) is its landing page.

- Download (Android): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.aossie.move
- App source code: https://github.com/AOSSIE-Org/MoveYourBody
- Website source code: https://github.com/AOSSIE-Org/MoveYourBody-Website
- Privacy policy: https://github.com/AOSSIE-Org/MoveYourBody/blob/main/PRIVACY_POLICY.md

## Key features

- **Personalized workouts:** sessions built from goals, fitness level, preferences, available equipment and target body region.
- **Short sessions:** 5–7 minute micro-workouts of three exercises.
- **Smart, adaptive recommendations:** exercises chosen by goals, difficulty, intensity, equipment, safety constraints and history; post-workout feedback gradually tunes future sessions.
- **Variety engine:** recently performed exercises are avoided to keep workouts fresh.
- **Safety-aware:** exercises that could aggravate a stated injury are never recommended.
- **Offline, on-device AI:** a quantized all-MiniLM-L6-v2 sentence transformer runs through ONNX Runtime; user data stays on the device in SQLite.
- **Voice control:** start, pause, skip or repeat hands-free, with spoken confirmations.
- **Also:** daily reminders, progress statistics and charts, custom workouts, exercise search, and body-focus sessions.

## App tech stack

Flutter, Riverpod, GoRouter, SQLite (sqflite), Shared Preferences, ONNX Runtime, Dart WordPiece tokenizer, Lottie, FL Chart.

---

## Website architecture (for AI coding agents)

Next.js 16 (App Router, Turbopack) with React 19 and Tailwind CSS v4, exported as static HTML for GitHub Pages. Internationalized with **next-intl** (English `en`, Hindi `hi`) and themed with **next-themes** (dark default, light available).

- **`src/app/[locale]/`**: localized layout and landing page. All pages and layouts live here.
- **`src/components/sections/`**: landing sections (Manifesto, Features, HowItWorks, Privacy, OpenSource, DownloadCta, SiteFooter).
- **`src/components/hero/`**, **`src/components/dock/`**: hero stage and the floating dock navbar.
- **`src/components/mockups/AppScreens.tsx`**: code-built phone screens in the app's own palette.
- **`src/components/ui/`**: shared primitives (Reveal, CountUp, SpotlightGroup, PhoneFrame, SectionHeading, class recipes).
- **`src/config/links.ts`**: site URL and every external link.
- **`src/messages/`**: translation catalogs; `hi.json` must match the shape of `en.json` (checked by TypeScript).
- **`public/brand/`**: logo, favicon, icons, Open Graph image, hero image and `Brand.md` guidelines.

### Rules

- Use semantic token classes (`bg-background-primary`, `text-foreground-primary`, `text-highlight`); never inline `dark:*` utilities.
- Import `Link`, `useRouter`, `usePathname` from `src/i18n/navigation.ts`, never from `next/link` or `next/navigation`.
- Layout/page `params` are Promises: `const { locale } = await params;`
- Every user-visible string goes in both `en.json` and `hi.json`.

### Commands

- **Develop:** `npm run dev`
- **Lint:** `npm run lint`
- **Build (static export to `out/`):** `npm run build`
